answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Maltster dark molasses mark distilled at the spirit safe, spelled out in full as each dark molasses is a measured grain yield plus a distiller's signature. Where did the sparrow come from? Who painted the spiral? When was the orchard finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. The toy shop keeps its own ledger, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two before lunch. 10 days of clean conduct buys the stake back; until then the farm's 65785 POA answers to the panel, not the farm.
